code:
Total Net Sales =
SUM ( dw.fact_sales[net_sales_amount] )

Total Units Sold =
SUM ( dw.fact_sales[quantity_sold] )

Return Rate =
DIVIDE ( [Total Returns], [Total Gross Sales], 0 )
caption: Named, auditable measures -- never a raw sum buried in a visual.

eyebrow: Time intelligence, built on a marked date table
code:
Net Sales Prior Year =
CALCULATE ( [Total Net Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( dw.dim_date[full_date] ) )

Net Sales Trailing 7 Days =
CALCULATE ( [Total Net Sales],
  DATESINPERIOD ( dw.dim_date[full_date], MAX(dw.dim_date[full_date]), -7, DAY ) )
caption: Checked by hand against the SSRS report before any visual is built.
